name: vita3g-disable
author: VictorGamer072YT
long_description:
This is a plugin that spoofs HasWWAN (vshSysconHasWWAN) to always return 0.
This has the effect of essentially tricking the system into thinking this is a regular WiFi only Vita.
This means, Mobile Network is gone from the Quick Menu, apps such as PSVident report the system as a WiFi vita, Mobile Network Operator won't work anymore (it will hang), Mobile Network Settings will be gone from the settings app, SIM errors and "No SIM" will be gone forever, you can now remove and reinsert the SIM card without the Vita forcing you to reboot, IMEI, Phone Number and ICCID will not show up in System Information anymore, the Usage option under System will no longer show up, etc.

name: taiHen
author: Team Molecule
description: Advanced HEN which brings kernel access and plugins support.
long_description:
taiHEN is a CFW framework for PS Vitaâ„¢. When loaded with a kernel exploit, it acts as a common substrate for patching the system. taiHEN provides three main facilities:
- It disables code signature checks to allow unsigned executables.
- It exposes kernel peek/poke syscalls to user applications and allows loading of kernel modules.
- Most importantly, it provides an API for hooking and replacing functions based off of substitute.

The last point means that developers can add custom patches to kernel, system applications, and games alike.
